The checker enumerates all points, branch roots and fixed 2-torsion classes for ten exact examples across genera three through six, with VERIFY_OK. Finite tests are corroboration, not infinity proof.

value.rationale: This computes a fundamental complete finite-group invariant over F_q for an unbounded-genus class with minimal automorphism group; maximality previously determined the order but not 2-primary elementary divisors. The dyadic dichotomy is a meaningful exact arithmetic classification, useful in the study of rational divisor classes, without asserting any unproved downstream theorem.
